lines.tok1: Text is chopped into tokens, and each token becomes a list of numbers, called an embedding.
lines.tok2: Words with similar meanings get similar numbers, so cat lands near dog.
lines.att1: To read a word, the model looks at every other word, and decides which ones matter.
lines.att2: That is attention. It points to animal, but change the ending, and it points to street.
lines.stack1: Dozens of stacked layers refine the meaning of every word.
lines.stack2: At the top, it scores the next token, and the loop starts again.
lines.outro: Tokens in, attention across them, one next word out. Repeat that, and you get a conversation.
